Panjab University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Panjab University Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being advertised by Panjab University?
faq.answer: Panjab University is recruiting for the post of Assistant Professor in Chemical Engineering. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Professor in Chemical Engineering position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 17 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. or Integrated M.Tech in Chemical Engineering with first class or equivalent in any one of the degrees.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The salary is offered on a per-lecture basis, with Rs. 1500/- per lecture and an upper limit of Rs. 50000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section provided in this article.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates (if applicable).
